item.title: Dog honored during Virginia basketball game poops on court
item.description: Virginia honored a retiring K-9 at its Tuesday basketball game. Unfortunately, not everything went as planned. As documented by Mike Barber, the dog went to the bathroom while on the John Paul Jones Arena court. item.title: Texas A&M erases double-digit first half deficit, beats Kentucky for 20th win of the season
item.description: Texas A&M trailed by 12 with eight minutes to go in the first half before coming back to beat Kentucky behind a 27-3 run. The post Texas A&M erases double-digit first half deficit, beats Kentucky for 20th win of the season appeared first on Saturday Down South.
